content2.content: A great app works offline. This involves caching data when online and serving it when offline, as well as queuing actions to be synced later.

content4.content:
Shared Preferences: Good for simple key-value pairs (settings, user flags).
Local Database (SQLite/Isar/Hive): Best for structured data (lists of posts, user profiles).
File Storage: Good for images and large assets.

content6.content:
Offline Banner: Show a non-intrusive banner indicating offline mode.
Disable Actions: Gray out buttons that require internet (e.g., 'Submit').
Empty States: If no cache exists, show a friendly 'No Connection' screen.

content8.content: When the app comes back online, trigger a sync process to send queued data (e.g., offline likes, new posts) to the server.

content10.content: Offline support is a key differentiator for high-quality apps. Plan your caching and sync strategy early in development.
